text: Quick install via pip or a prepackaged Docker image lets you launch a first ELT pipeline within minutes
quote: Meltano is pip-installable and comes in a prepackaged docker container, you can have your first ELT pipeline running within minutes.

text: CLI command scaffolds a new Meltano project in a chosen directory
quote: Initialize a new project in a directory of your choosing using meltano init

text: Add a connector (e.g. GitHub extractor) to a project with a single CLI command, auto-detected by type
quote: Add the GitHub extractor ... meltano add tap-github

text: Framework/SDK to build a custom connector that moves data from any source to any destination
quote: Build your own Meltano connector to move data from any source to any destination.

text: Access to 600+ built-in connectors covering APIs and databases
quote: Access to 600+ built-in connectors

text: Transformations are run via built-in dbt integration
quote: Transformations in Meltano are implemented using dbt.

text: Scheduled pipelines can be orchestrated using Apache Airflow
quote: Meltano supports scheduled pipelines that can be orchestrated using Apache Airflow.

text: Add a Dockerfile/.dockerignore bundle to containerize a project
quote: you can easily add the appropriate Dockerfile and .dockerignore files to your project by adding the docker file bundle

text: Test a plugin's configuration with a dedicated CLI command before running it
quote: its configuration can be tested using meltano config test <plugin>

text: Customize the extraction catalog by selecting which streams and properties to pull
quote: Meltano can handle catalog generation for you, by letting you describe your desired modifications using stream selection

text: Guide exists to migrate an existing dbt project into a Meltano project
quote: If you already have an existing dbt project that you'd like to migrate to Meltano, check out the existing dbt project guide

text: Savings estimator tool to compare Meltano's cost against Fivetran
quote: If you're on Fivetran, use our savings estimator tool to see how much you can save with Meltano!

text: Built-in pipeline monitoring and alerting
quote: Built-in pipeline monitoring and alerts

text: Reverse ETL capability included in the product
quote: Reverse ETL included

text: Extractors are responsible for pulling data out of any data source
quote: An extractor is responsible for pulling data out of any data source.

text: Projects are composed of typed plugins: extractors, loaders, and utilities
quote: your project and pipelines are composed of plugins of different types, most notably extractors, loaders, utilities

text: Projects can follow standard software practices: version control, code review, CI/CD
quote: you can treat it like any other software development project and benefit from DataOps best practices such as version control, code review, and continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD)

text: Tracks incremental replication state so subsequent runs resume where the previous run left off
quote: keeps track of the incremental replication state, so that subsequent pipeline runs with the same state ID will always pick up right where the previous run left off

text: Self-host and manage the entire stack on your own servers
quote: You host and manage everything on your own servers

text: Optional hosted offering where Meltano hosts, scales, and maintains everything for you
quote: Meltano hosts, scales, and maintains everything for you

text: Pricing model based on compute usage rather than per-row data volume
quote:
Your data bill shouldn't keep growing.  
Pay for compute. Not rows.

text: Idempotent CLI command to add or update project plugins
quote: `meltano add` lets you add or update [plugins](/concepts/plugins#project-plugins) in your Meltano project. The command is idempotent

text: Run all pipelines—across databases, files, SaaS tools, and dbt workflows—in one place
quote: Run all pipelines in one place, across databases, files, SaaS tools, internal systems, and workflows like dbt.

text: Build, adjust, and debug connectors directly instead of waiting on a vendor ticket queue
quote: Build, adjust, and debug connectors directly. You are not blocked by ticket queues

text: SDK for Singer connectors and EDK for Meltano components to build integrations
quote: The SDK for Singer Connectors & EDK for Meltano Components are easy to use.

text: Plugins are declared as code in a project config file under typed arrays (extractors, loaders, etc.)
quote: Your project's plugins ... are defined under the plugins property, inside an array named after the plugin type (e.g. extractors, loaders).

text: Project can be wrapped into a project-specific Docker image for deployment
quote: you can greatly simplify this process ... by wrapping them all up into a project-specific Docker container image

text: Slim Docker images available for faster container startup when using cloud storage destinations
quote: Use slim images if you: Primarily use cloud storage (S3, GCS, Azure Blob Storage) ... Want faster container startup and deployment times

text: CLI to manage a project, its plugins, and EL(T) pipelines
quote: Meltano provides a command line interface (CLI) that makes it easy to manage your project, plugins, and EL(T) pipelines.

text: Paid plans include a fixed amount of engineering support hours per month
quote: 8 hours of engineering on demand/mo

text: Run EL(T) pipelines end-to-end with a single meltano run command
quote: You can run EL(T) pipelines using [`meltano run`]

text: Fully own and self-host the entire data infrastructure for free
quote: Own every part of your data infrastructure, on your own servers, free forever.

text: List all available plugin settings, environment variables, and current values via CLI
quote: meltano config list <plugin> to list all available settings with their names, environment variables, and current values.
